name: yolox_person
licence_verified: 2026-08-11. opencv_zoo weights: read models/object_detection_yolox/LICENSE, confirmed Apache-2.0. Megvii release weights: covered by the YOLOX repository's Apache-2.0 licence.

preprocessing.resize: letterbox to the model input size, pad value 114, ratio = min(H_in/h, W_in/w), top-left placement
preprocessing.colour_note: Upstream YOLOX preproc does no colour conversion, so Megvii release exports expect BGR. OpenCV Zoo's demo applies cvtColor(BGR2RGB) before inference, so the zoo re-export expects RGB. Measured 2026-08-11 on a pedestrian clip: official yolox_nano found 8 people with BGR vs 6 with RGB. Wrong order degrades silently.

files.note: Fallback if nano's accuracy proves insufficient and the fps budget allows.
OpenCV Zoo re-export. Benchmarked as an upper bound on cost; too heavy for the target CPU.
Benchmarked 11x SLOWER than fp32 on AMD Zen 2 (no AVX512-VNNI). See PLAN.md section 9.2.
